storeInfo.name: Riverbend Pizza & Restaurant
storeInfo.tagline: Authentic Italian Pizza and Family Dining in Southington

policies.restroomLocationEs: Ubicado hacia la parte trasera del salón principal.
policies.restroomLocationEn: Located towards the back of the main dining room.
policies.restroomCodeEn: Open for dining guests (no code required).
policies.parkingPolicyEs: Estacionamiento disponible en el lote contiguo o en la calle.
policies.parkingPolicyEn: Parking available in adjacent lot or street parking.
policies.returnPolicyEs: Nos esforzamos por la satisfacción total; por favor notifique a su mesero de inmediato.
policies.returnPolicyEn: We strive for complete guest satisfaction; please notify your server immediately.
policies.deliveryPolicyEs: Servicio para llevar disponible por teléfono y plataformas de entrega locales.
policies.deliveryPolicyEn: Takeout service available by phone and local delivery platforms.

products.descriptionEs: Bastones de mozzarella empanizados y fritos a la perfección, servidos con salsa marinara casera.
products.descriptionEn: Breaded mozzarella sticks fried to golden perfection, served with house-made marinara sauce.

products.descriptionEs: Alitas de pollo crujientes bañadas en nuestra salsa picante especial, servidas con aderezo de queso azul.
products.descriptionEn: Crispy chicken wings tossed in our signature spicy buffalo sauce, served with blue cheese dressing.

products.descriptionEs: Pan italiano crujiente horneado con mantequilla de ajo fresco y una capa generosa de queso mozzarella derretido.
products.descriptionEn: Crispy Italian bread baked with fresh garlic butter and a generous topping of melted mozzarella cheese.

products.descriptionEs: Nuestra pizza insignia cargada de pepperoni, salchicha italiana, champiñones, pimientos, cebollas y aceitunas negras.
products.descriptionEn: Our signature pizza loaded with pepperoni, Italian sausage, mushrooms, bell peppers, onions, and black olives.

products.descriptionEs: Salsa de tomate San Marzano, mozzarella fresca, albahaca orgánica y un chorrito de aceite de oliva virgen extra.
products.descriptionEn: San Marzano tomato sauce, fresh mozzarella, organic basil, and a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil.

products.descriptionEs: Para los amantes de la carne: pepperoni, tocino crujiente, salchicha italiana, albóndigas y jamón.
products.descriptionEn: For meat enthusiasts: loaded with pepperoni, crispy bacon, Italian sausage, meatballs, and savory ham.

products.descriptionEs: Pechuga de pollo empanizada cubierta con salsa marinara y queso mozzarella derretido, servida con pasta spaghetti.
products.descriptionEn: Breaded chicken breast topped with marinara sauce and melted mozzarella cheese, served with a side of spaghetti.

products.descriptionEs: Fettuccine fresco bañado en nuestra rica y cremosa salsa de queso parmesano y mantequilla.
products.descriptionEn: Fresh fettuccine tossed in our rich, creamy house-made parmesan cheese and butter sauce.

products.descriptionEs: Capas de pasta ancha, carne sazonada, ricotta cremosa, marinara y mucho queso mozzarella dorado.
products.descriptionEn: Layers of wide pasta, seasoned ground beef, creamy ricotta, marinara, and lots of golden melted mozzarella.

products.nameEs: Calzone Relleno de Queso y Jamón
products.descriptionEs: Masa de pizza doblada y rellena de jamón ahumado, ricotta cremosa y mozzarella, servida con marinara.
products.descriptionEn: Folded pizza dough stuffed with smoked ham, creamy ricotta, and mozzarella, served with a side of marinara.

products.nameEs: Refresco de Frasco (Cola, Diet Cola, Sprite)
products.descriptionEs: Bebida gaseosa fría y refrescante en vaso grande con hielo.
products.descriptionEn: Cold and refreshing fountain carbonated beverage served in a large cup with ice.

products.descriptionEs: Té negro recién infusionado, ligeramente endulzado y servido con una rodaja de limón fresco.
products.descriptionEn: Freshly brewed black tea, lightly sweetened and served over ice with a slice of fresh lemon.

faqs.qEn: Do you offer vegetarian or gluten-free options?
faqs.aEs: Sí, ofrecemos varias opciones vegetarianas y podemos preparar pizzas seleccionadas con masa sin gluten bajo pedido.
faqs.aEn: Yes, we offer several vegetarian options and can prepare selected pizzas with a gluten-free crust upon request.

faqs.qEn: Do you accept reservations for large groups?
faqs.aEs: Aceptamos clientes sin reservación y también reservaciones telefónicas para familias o grupos grandes.
faqs.aEn: We welcome walk-ins and also accept phone reservations for families and large groups.
